_note: ARAM builds for full champion roster. Patch 26.9 / Season 16. Updated 2026-05-03 (s33 phase merge - 77 champions refreshed via public build-statistics aggregators).
_provenance: Compiled from public third-party League build-statistics aggregators. The per-champion source URLs and fetch records that used to live here were removed before this repository was published; no replacement URLs have been substituted. The underlying fetches ran 2026-05-02 and were merged 2026-05-03. Win-rate and game-count figures in this file are the values those aggregators reported at that time - they are observed community statistics, not Riot-official data.
_format: build_note is the coaching-relevant line injected into ARAM coach system prompt.

Aatrox.build_note: Conqueror sustain bruiser - Sundered Sky heal proc + Eclipse shield carry the long fights.
Aatrox.vs_healing: Maw of Malmortius (63.0% WR pickup vs heavy AP)
Aatrox.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs poke burst
Aatrox.kit_notes: Sweet-spot Q drag-fighter; healing-lock R demands antiheal and forces engages.

Ahri.build_note: Note tier B (down from old A) - the external aggregator WR 51.5%. Charm + Luden stacking still does the burst, but kit feels behind the better S-tier mages this patch.
Ahri.vs_tanks: Void Staff replaces Shadowflame 6th - flat-AP burst kit not anti-tank by design
Ahri.vs_healing: Morellonomicon (46.9% WR - worst-WR situational) - only vs Soraka/Sona stacked
Ahri.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil 5th replaces Rabadon - spell shield blocks pick-CC chains
Ahri.kit_notes: E (Charm) is the combo opener - Charmed enemies take 20% bonus damage from all sources. Full combo: E-charm → W orbs → Q returning charm → R dash1-burst → R dash2-escape. R 3-dash reset on kill - never use R to engage; R-execute then escape.
Ahri.aram_specific: ARAM neutral (no modifier). R-resets in ARAM are the win - wait for low-HP enemies, R-charm-execute, then R-escape. Don't open with R in 5v5.

Akali.build_note: Electrocute hybrid - Gunblade omnivamp keeps her alive between Shadowflame/Stormsurge bursts.
Akali.vs_healing: Morellonomicon (Akali's W heal makes Grievous on enemies a side-benefit)
Akali.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Lich Bane vs burst
Akali.kit_notes: Energy assassin; W shroud + R dash chain in/out, but no Flash on this map = pick spots.

Akshan.build_note: Heroic Swing (E) hooks terrain for aerial mobility - use as escape OR to flank. W (Going Rogue) marks villains; kill the villain to revive all allies that villain killed. Phantom Dancer ghost supplements E for gap-closing. Comeuppance (R) long channel that one-shots; use after E to dodge counterattack.
Akshan.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both
Akshan.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces The Collector vs heavy burst

Alistar.build_note: W-Q combo (headbutt then pulverize): W dashes + knocks back, immediately Q to knock up. This must be done in order: W → Q. Combo: dash behind enemy carry → W to knock them toward team → Q to knock up at feet of your team. R Unbreakable Will negates 75% of damage - activate when being dove to become nearly unkillable for 7 seconds.
Alistar.vs_tanks: Thornmail - autos apply grievous during W headbutt chain
Alistar.vs_burst: Unbreakable Will (R) reduces damage by 75% - activate when focused

Ambessa.build_note: Cunning (passive) marks enemies - next attack deals bonus damage. Grand Entrance (W) AOE dash with follow-up. Restock (Q) refreshes W - dash then Q refresh for second dash. Vicious Assault (E) forward rush. Grand Entrance (R) full screen dash to a target followed by explosions. High mobility fighter - chain dashes to reach backline.
Ambessa.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's - physical damage full armor pen
Ambessa.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both
Ambessa.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Death's Dance vs burst

Amumu.build_note: Aftershock tank - Sunfire/Heartsteel HP+aura damage is the scaling shell.
Amumu.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst
Amumu.kit_notes: AoE-stun ult engage tank; flash-R is the wombo button on this map.

Annie.build_note: Tier D - 49.9% WR is genuinely bad. Annie's burst floor is lower than the current S-tier mage pool (Lux/Sera/Brand/Ziggs all out-burst her). Standard burst build still optimal among Annie options.
Annie.vs_tanks: Liandry's Torment (54.5% WR) replaces Shadowflame - burn beats Annie's flat-AP scaling vs tanks
Annie.vs_healing: Morellonomicon (54.6% WR) replaces Zhonya's vs healing comp - give up Tibbers safety for cut
Annie.vs_burst: Zhonya's Hourglass already core - Banshee's Veil swap if all-AP enemies
Annie.kit_notes: Passive Pyromania: every 4th cast stuns target (counter on her bar). Q on cast OR kill refunds mana - last-hit minions to maintain mana. R (Summon Tibbers) AOE damage + stun if passive ready. R+E shield burst is ARAM's 1.5s combo.
Annie.aram_specific: ARAM neutral. Pyromania-stun + R is her only kill window - count Q/W casts on minion wave to ensure stun ready before fight. Tibbers is a bait absorber - 7s tank when summoned.

Aphelios.build_note: Lethal Tempo crit - Collector+IE+Runaan's covers AoE-poke and execute simultaneously.
Aphelios.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow 4th replaces The Collector vs heavy burst dive
Aphelios.kit_notes: Weapon-cycle ADC; Calibrum poke + Severum heal makes him the safest ARAM marksman pick.
Aphelios.aram_specific: Infernum (blue flame) ult in grouped ARAM = AOE sweep hitting everyone. Pre-stack Gravitum (grey chains) before fights for root. Place Crescendum turret at chokepoints during laning. Calibrum Q at max range for free poke between weapons.

Ashe.build_note: Lethal Tempo Runaan's spread - perma-slow the team while IE/BORK shred the front.
Ashe.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster - ISB + perma-slow = bait dive then shield
Ashe.kit_notes: Slow-on-AA + global ult - peels and engages from poke range; the safest Howling Abyss carry.
Ashe.aram_specific: R from fountain range hits any grouped ARAM fight. Never stand in melee range - RFC + max range Frost Shot means you can slow everything without being in danger. Q stack up before fights using minions, then dump on enemy frontline for AOE slow.

Aurelion Sol.build_note: DoT/CC mage rush - Blackfire+Rylai's slow lock targets so Liandry/Shadowflame burn tick.
Aurelion Sol.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Rylai's vs burst
Aurelion Sol.kit_notes: Stacking-mage that orbits stars; needs to scale and kite - every star stacks DPS uptime.

Aurora.build_note: Two Worlds (R) creates a realm that empowers Aurora's abilities - activate before full combo. Q (Twofold Hex) marks then detonates on second cast. W (Across the Void) hop over terrain - use for repositioning escape. E (Between Worlds) teleports to other side of gap. Lich Bane procs on Q detonation for bonus damage on landing.
Aurora.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Azir.build_note: Soldiers (W) attack anything Azir autos. Q (Conquering Sands) sends soldiers forward - move soldier to group, then Q to shove multiple enemies. E (Arise) summons soldier at obelisk. R (Emperor's Divide) wall of soldiers pushes enemies and blocks movement. In ARAM: place soldiers at max range and spam Q to harass the entire line. R blocks entire enemy advance at chokepoints.
Azir.vs_tanks: Void Staff - all magic; soldiers apply on-hit
Azir.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Bard.build_note: Cosmic Binding (Q) stuns when it hits two targets or passes through and hits terrain. Caretaker's Shrine (W) health packs that fill over time - place near health packs for double-pack. Magical Journey (E) tunnel for allies - place tunnels through walls to create escape routes. Tempered Fate (R) freezes EVERYTHING in an area including allies and enemies - use to freeze enemy team or save dying allies. Collect Chimes for haste.
Bard.vs_burst: Locket of the Iron Solari in core

Bel'Veth.build_note: Lavender Sea (passive) RAMPANT GROWTH: attack speed from kills, permanent AS stacks. Void Surge (Q) 4 directional dashes - always Q toward target for attack speed proc. Above and Below (W) tail slam knockup. Royal Maelstrom (E) damage reduction + heavy attacks during channel. Endless Banquet (R) Void form: enhanced stats and true form. On-hit build amplifies every Lavender Sea auto.
Bel'Veth.vs_tanks: Kraken + LDR - Lavender Sea on-hit stacks multiply with Kraken
Bel'Veth.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both
Bel'Veth.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Mortal Reminder vs burst

Blitzcrank.build_note: Q (Rocket Grab) is your entire game - hit it, win the fight. Hook carries, not tanks. E (Power Fist) uppercutt after hook for airborne extension. R (Static Field) suppresses nearby enemies - use in group fights for silence + damage. Never hook tanks. Prioritize isolated carries stepping forward for health packs.
Blitzcrank.vs_tanks: Thornmail - grievous on autos after hook
Blitzcrank.vs_burst: Force of Nature replaces Frozen Heart vs heavy AP

Brand.build_note: Blackfire Torch + Liandry double %HP burn make tanks evaporate. Rylai slows the bouncing R targets so it chains longer. Sustained AOE - never the burst champ but always the highest-damage scoreboard.
Brand.vs_tanks: Liandry's already in core - both Liandry + Blackfire scale on max HP, double-amp vs tanks
Brand.vs_healing: Morellonomicon replaces Shadowflame 6th, OR Bloodletter's Curse (53.4% WR per the external aggregator)
Brand.vs_burst: Zhonya's Hourglass (56.8% WR) replaces Shadowflame vs assassin dive - long-channel R safe
Brand.kit_notes: Passive Blaze: 3 stacks ignite for max-HP burn. Q stuns ablazed targets. W AOE on ablazed = wider radius. R (Pyroclasm) bounces between champions, prioritizing ablazed - stack 3 on tank, fire R into enemy line for chain bounce. AOE-damage carry.
Brand.aram_specific: +15% damage dealt, no damage-taken modifier - ARAM's most-buffed AOE mage. Ult in narrow lane bounces forever - fire from screen edge. Avoid Q starts (no jungle) - Lost Chapter stack first.

Braum.build_note: Stand Behind Me (W) leap to ally - stay attached to your ADC. Unbreakable (E) blocks projectiles including Jinx rockets, Lux ult, Ashe ult - face the damage. R (Glacial Fissure) knockup along a line - throw diagonally across ARAM corridor. Concussive Blows: mark with Q, let allies complete 4-stack stun.
Braum.vs_tanks: Thornmail applies grievous on autos - Concussive Blows needs 4 stacks from allies
Braum.vs_burst: Aegis of the Legion (component) into Locket gives team-wide shield

Briar.build_note: Conqueror hybrid sustain - Sundered Sky + Spirit Visage stack heal amp, BORK for frontliners.
Briar.vs_healing: Death's Dance (Grievous via item curtailed; rely on Executioner's component)
Briar.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs burst
Briar.kit_notes: Self-fearing bruiser; you don't kite, you berserk - frontline at 30% HP.

Caitlyn.build_note: Lethality-into-crit hybrid (Serrated Dirk start for early MS + lethality, then full crit). Note: Hubris was an option here but received 26.9 nerfs (60->55 AD); The Collector is the safer first crit.
Caitlyn.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards (52.9% WR) in core - 35% armor pen plus %HP damage
Caitlyn.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder (51.6% WR) replaces Lord Dominik's - pick one anti-tank slot, never both
Caitlyn.vs_burst: Bloodthirster (52.0% WR) replaces The Collector vs heavy poke comp - shield + lifesteal
Caitlyn.kit_notes: Passive Headshot: every 6th AA / every AA after E or trap deals bonus damage with extended range. W (Yordle Snap Trap) - pre-place at chokes for guaranteed Headshot. E (90 Caliber Net) self-knockback escape + slow. R (Ace in the Hole) channeled snipe - execute low-HP across screen.
Caitlyn.aram_specific: ARAM neutral. Long range = poke from screen-edge; never engage forward. R execution from base finishes ARAM-stranded low-HP. Place W traps in choke before fights start.

Camille.build_note: Conqueror Trinity rush - Sheen procs win extended trades; Hydra clears the wave gridlock.
Camille.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs burst
Camille.kit_notes: Precision duelist with E hookshot engage and R isolation - pick squishies off the flank.

Cassiopeia.build_note: Mana-scaling RoA→Archangel sustain into Liandry's tick - Rylai's is the in-built kite.
Cassiopeia.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Morellonomicon vs burst
Cassiopeia.kit_notes: Ranged DoT mage with poisoned ground area-denial; rooted to stay on top of targets without Flash chain.

Cho'Gath.build_note: Grasp HP-stack tank - Warmog's + Heartsteel + R-stacks = >5k HP late game.
Cho'Gath.vs_tanks: Unending Despair (passive AoE damage scales with HP)
Cho'Gath.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst
Cho'Gath.kit_notes: Stack-eating CC tank - feast stacks on champ kills, true-damage R executes.

Corki.build_note: 50% AD / 50% Magic mixed damage - partially ignores both resistances. Package (Special Delivery) mega-bomb does massive magic damage and leaves fire. Phosphorus Bombs (Q) reveal brush. Valkyrie (W) napalm trail - fly over enemy group for damage zone. Gatling Gun (E) shreds both armor and MR. TF Spellblade procs on every spell for bonus magic damage.
Corki.vs_tanks: LDR - TF(0%)+Collector(25%)+RFC(25%)+IE(25%)=75% crit; Q is magic damage
Corki.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both
Corki.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces The Collector vs burst

Darius.build_note: Conqueror Stridebreaker rush gives the slow he needs to land Q and dunk through the choke.
Darius.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage in core - activates at low HP
Darius.kit_notes: Bleed/dunk fighter; Q outer-edge heal + R reset is the team-fight loop.

Diana.build_note: Dark Harvest burst rush - Stormsurge/Rocketbelt for mid-game one-shots; Conqueror+Heartsteel is a 54.7% niche.
Diana.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke
Diana.kit_notes: Lunar burst-assassin/diver; Q crescent + R pull = melee threat that can also frontline.

Dr. Mundo.build_note: Adrenaline Rush (passive) heals 0.8% max HP per second. All abilities cost HP. Maximum Dosage (R) gains 20% HP instantly AND heals %max HP over 10s - use R when at 30% HP for full sustain recovery. Infected Bonesaw (Q) slows and does % current HP magic damage. Blunt Force Trauma (E) empowered autos deal bonus HP damage. Face Breaker (W) pins enemies to terrain - use to prevent enemy escape. Build max HP: every % heal ability heals more.
Dr. Mundo.vs_tanks: Thornmail - Maximum Dosage (R) heals % of max HP - more HP = more R heal
Dr. Mundo.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Force of Nature vs burst

Draven.build_note: Tier D - 46.9% WR. Draven without lane-snowball gold engine = behind. Q-axe positioning is hard in ARAM density. Standard Collector+IE+BT crit-with-lifesteal build - Shieldbow swap survives ARAM dive comps.
Draven.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards (51.5% WR) in core - Draven AAs are massive damage, %pen amps
Draven.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder (42.5% WR - bad) - Draven kit no synergy with anti-heal slot
Draven.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow (54.4% WR) replaces Bloodthirster - shield triggers below 30% HP, saves Draven from one-shots
Draven.kit_notes: Passive League of Draven: kill enemies = stacks for gold (cash out by killing more). Q (Spinning Axe) bonus AD on next AA - catch axe to refresh; AAs bounce off enemies and you reposition to catch. R (Whirling Death) global piercing axe - return-on-recast through entire enemy team.
Draven.aram_specific: ARAM neutral. Q-axes auto-fall around Draven; in ARAM crowd you're catching axes between minion waves. R from spawn at low-HP enemies - recast for double-pass through entire enemy line.

Ekko.build_note: W (Parallel Convergence) circle: place it on where enemy group WILL BE, it activates 3s later for a stun. Z-Drive Resonance (passive): 3 ability hits stun the target briefly. R (Chronobreak) rewinds to ghost position from 3s ago AND deals damage in AOE around it - use when low HP to escape AND damage. TF Spellblade procs on Q for massive burst.
Ekko.vs_tanks: Void Staff - W circle applies slow and can stun on second activation
Ekko.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke burst

Elise.build_note: Human form: E cocoon stuns → Q burst → W volatile spiderling. Spider form: Q pounce → E rappel dodge → auto autos with spiderlings. Cocoon → Q → swap to spider → Q pounce → rappel to dodge counterattack. Rappel (Spider E) makes Elise untargetable briefly - use to dodge enemy ultimates mid-combo.
Elise.vs_tanks: Void Staff - all magic; cocoon into spider dive combo
Elise.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Evelynn.build_note: Last Caress (R) execute: double damage below 35% HP AND dashes away after. Allure (W) charm: stacks reduce MR when detonated. Hate Spike (Q) fires 4 times - each hit deals more damage than the last. Ravage (E) two swipes. ARAM: no invisibility without deep stealth so play aggressively: W charm → Q spam → E → R execute and escape.
Evelynn.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Ezreal.build_note: Tier C - 50.3% WR. Pure-AD on-hit Trinity build over the old AP-Ez variant. Spear of Shojin is the 26.9 retention; Manamune scales infinitely off Tear stacks (ARAM = unlimited mana for stacking).
Ezreal.vs_tanks: Serylda's Grudge in core - Ezreal Q+passive scales with on-hit, %pen mandatory
Ezreal.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder (41.2% WR - worst situational) - Ez can't drop crit slot easily
Ezreal.vs_burst: Maw of Malmortius (50.6% WR) replaces Serylda's - magic shield + lifeline vs AP comp
Ezreal.kit_notes: Passive Rising Spell Force: AS stacks per spell hit - keep Q'ing minions. Q (Mystic Shot) on-hit applies items + reduces all CDs by 1.5s - Trinity Force Spellblade procs every Q. E (Arcane Shift) blink + AA - reposition tool. R (Trueshot Barrage) global, low-priority finisher.
Ezreal.aram_specific: +10% damage taken - Ez ARAM nerf. Q-poke from screen-edge is the safe play; never engage forward. E-blink wall-jumps work in ARAM lane edges. Tear stacking is faster in ARAM - Manamune by 12 min.

Fiddlesticks.build_note: Malignance ult-CDR rush, Liandry+Shadowflame for AoE tick - Zhonya is mandatory because R locks you in place.
Fiddlesticks.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke
Fiddlesticks.kit_notes: Fear/AoE menace; channeled R is the team-fight pivot - find the brush or the bait.

Fiora.build_note: Grand Challenge (R) reveals all 4 Vitals on one target - burst all 4 for massive heal. Vitals (passive) deal % max HP true damage regardless of armor - always be hitting the glowing Vital. Lunge (Q) two-part dash to target; resets on Vital hit. Riposte (W) parry + counter - use W exactly when enemy ability hits to reflect back. Bladework (E) empowered autos. ARAM: TF Spellblade + Vital true damage = shred any tank.
Fiora.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's - Vitals (passive) % max HP true damage ignores armor entirely
Fiora.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both
Fiora.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs burst

Fizz.build_note: Dark Harvest burst - Luden's procs, Lich Bane on E reset doubles up; Heartsteel-Grasp variant hits 57.4% niche.
Fizz.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke
Fizz.kit_notes: E untargetable + R fish-spawn is the burst chain; ARAM crowding makes R hits trivial.

Galio.build_note: Aftershock tank - Heartsteel + Winter's Approach scaling + MR/armor shells, not the AP variant.
Galio.vs_tanks: Kaenic Rookern (58.2% WR - MR-stacking shield breaks tank-mage trades)
Galio.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst
Galio.kit_notes: Tank-mage with CC, MR-scaling damage, and a global ult that the ARAM lane bottlenecks for.

Gangplank.build_note: Trinity Force first for Spellblade on Q crits. Collector (25%) + RFC (25%) + IE (25%) = 75% total crit - IE passive fully active. Q with RFC fires empowered long-range shot. Barrel chains (E): connect 3 for massive AOE slow + fire. R (Cannon Barrage) globally every fight.
Gangplank.vs_tanks: LDR - Parrrley (Q) crits and applies LDR through armor
Gangplank.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both

Garen.build_note: Conqueror crit-Stridebreaker - Phantom Dancer + IE turns E into ranged-equivalent DPS.
Garen.kit_notes: Spinning crit-fighter; W tenacity + execute R = unkillable wave-clear with a finisher.
_filtered_items: Galeforce removed from League - N/A here, Phantom Dancer functions as the analog crit-mobility item.

Gnar.build_note: Grasp/Heartsteel build is highest WR (55.5%); Trinity is the more flexible default.
Gnar.vs_healing: Kaenic Rookern (vs heavy AP teams; Mortal Reminder for AD-heal compositions)
Gnar.kit_notes: Mini→Mega rage cycle; ranged poke until R, then ult engage when Mega bar is full.

Gragas.build_note: Barrel Roll (Q) exploding barrel - can be detonated early with recast. Body Slam (E) charge: stuns on hit. Explosive Cask (R) keg blast THROWS enemies - use to knock carries away from their team or throw tanks into YOUR team. Happy Hour (passive) heals on ability cast. Drunken Rage (W) channel briefly then empowered auto. R direction matters: aim BEHIND carries to throw them deeper into your team.
Gragas.vs_tanks: Void Staff - AP tank hybrid; Body Slam damage scales with AP
Gragas.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Graves.build_note: Buckshot (Q) spreads at close range for full damage - step close before Q for all pellets to hit. Smoke Screen (W) blocks enemy vision and slows inside - drop it on grouped enemies for maximum disorientation. Quickdraw (E) gives armor stacks per use - dash before taking burst for shield. R (Collateral Damage) knockback: use to push frontline away and finish backline. RELOAD between autos - plan movements around reload time.
Graves.vs_tanks: LDR - True Grit passive reduces damage from frontline, LDR shreds them
Graves.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing
Graves.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster vs burst

Gwen.build_note: Hallowed Mist (W) magic mist: in mist, Gwen takes 25% less damage and enemies outside CANNOT target her. Place W, step in, and swing freely. Snip Snip! (Q) scissors can only be dodged by stepping out of the cone - Hallowed Mist blocks escape. Thousand Cuts (passive) on-hit magic percent HP damage. Riftmaker sustains extended fights. Keep W active during every teamfight.
Gwen.vs_tanks: Void Staff - all magic; Needlework and Snip synergize with AP
Gwen.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Hecarim.build_note: Rampage (Q) reduces cooldown per hit - chain Q stacks for continuous damage cycle. Spirit of Dread (W) heals Hecarim for % of damage allies deal during its duration - use during grouped teamfights for massive heal. Devastating Charge (E) charge up then ram: more MS = more damage. Onslaught of Shadows (R) ghost charge with fear AOE - charge through ARAM corridor for multi-fear.
Hecarim.vs_tanks: LDR - Rampage (Q) stacks and scales with bonus AD (TF provides this)
Hecarim.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both

Heimerdinger.build_note: Liandry+Rylai is the AOE-burn-into-slow loop turrets feed off - every turret AA procs Liandry. Heimer's S-tier in ARAM is the single-lane choke pattern: drop 3 turrets in a triangle, force enemies through.
Heimerdinger.vs_tanks: Void Staff (53.4% WR) replaces Zhonya's 6th vs MR-stack tanks
Heimerdinger.vs_healing: Morellonomicon (49.0% WR) replaces Rylai's vs healing comps
Heimerdinger.vs_burst: Zhonya's Hourglass in core - Banshee's swap vs single AP burst (Lux/Xerath)
Heimerdinger.kit_notes: Passive: turret AAs apply Hextech magic damage to nearby targets (mini-AOE). Q places turrets - 3 charges, build a wall in chokes. W rocket barrage hits priority target (low HP). R upgrades next ability - Q-R = giant turret with cannon, W-R = guided missiles. ARAM single-lane ideal for turret choke.
Heimerdinger.aram_specific: +10% damage taken (Heimer ARAM nerf) - but turrets dealt 30% bonus damage in ARAM (offset). Set up turrets BEFORE fights - never engage without Q-R cannon ready. Single-lane geometry favors his W rockets.

Hwei.build_note: QE (Severing Bolt) marks and deals damage after delay - use on stationary/slowed targets. QW (Molten Fissure) AOE burn in ARAM corridor. WE (Grim Visage) fears enemies - use to interrupt grouped dives. EQ (Gaze of the Abyss) roots caught enemies. R (Spiraling Despair) - massive AOE that despairs all enemies within: use during enemy engage for max impact.
Hwei.vs_tanks: Void Staff + QQ (Devastating Fire) for % HP damage
Hwei.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs long-range poke

Illaoi.build_note: Grasp sustain - Sundered Sky heal-proc + Iceborn slow stack to hold targets in tentacle range.
Illaoi.kit_notes: Tentacle bruiser; R drops a soul-arena - fight inside it, never outside.

Irelia.build_note: Bladesurge (Q) resets on kills including minions - stay near minion wave for reset chains. Ionian Fervor (passive) stacks on ability hits: 6 stacks = max DPS window. E (Flawless Duet) - two blades that stun between them: throw E1 behind enemy, E2 in front for guaranteed stun. R (Vanguard's Edge) - don't chase with it, use to set up E stuns.
Irelia.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's slow - Bladesurge to low-HP minions after killing a champion
Irelia.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing (never both)
Irelia.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs heavy burst

Ivern.build_note: Daisy (R) summons a giant plant companion that fights for Ivern - send Daisy at the carry. Rootcaller (Q) roots an enemy; Ivern or Daisy can dash to rooted target. Brushmaker (W) creates brush for stealth and MS. Triggerseed (E) shield that explodes after 2s - put on diving ally for AoE slow explosion. In ARAM: E shield on aggressor to punish dives, Q root the carry, Daisy attacks them.
Ivern.vs_tanks: No anti-tank - Daisy (R) does the fighting
Ivern.vs_burst: Locket of the Iron Solari in core

Janna.build_note: Tier C - 50.4% WR. Janna's peel kit is consistent but the meta is engage-tank/burst-mage; her disengage loses tempo. Standard enchanter build optimal.
Janna.vs_tanks: Imperial Mandate (51.9% WR) replaces Ardent - chain-mark tanks for ally execute
Janna.vs_healing: Ardent Censer (55.3% WR) - Janna is HEALING-side; if facing healing, Morellonomicon awkward (41.8%)
Janna.vs_burst: Mikael's Blessing OR Locket of the Iron Solari (55.6% WR) - burst-peel kit
Janna.kit_notes: Passive: AAs gain bonus MS for self/ally. Q charge-up tornado knockup - long range engage/disengage. W (Zephyr) MS + slow target. R (Monsoon) AOE knockback + heal channel - disengage when team is grouped.
Janna.aram_specific: +10% damage taken in ARAM. R is the panic button - knockback all enemies when team is collapsing. Pre-position R away from team to push enemies into your own team's range.

Jarvan IV.build_note: Demacian Standard (E) flag + Dragon Strike (Q) under it = dash and knock-up at flag location. Combo: throw E flag → Q through target → knock-up → Cataclysm (R) for arena cage. R traps the carry in an enclosed arena - burst them before they escape. R creates terrain so anyone in the cage cannot leave (unless they have a dash). In ARAM: E+Q knock-up → R cage the carry → burst.
Jarvan IV.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's - Demacian Standard + Cataclysm burst scaling
Jarvan IV.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both

Jax.build_note: Counter Strike (E) dodges all auto attacks for 2s then stuns in AOE - use vs any auto-attack carry. Stack AS stacks (Relentless Assault passive) then E to dodge burst then stun. Grandmaster's Might (R) active: AOE on every third auto for 8s - maintain auto weaving during R. Leaping Strike (Q) gap-close, applies on-hit. Empower (W) empowered auto after Q for double proc.
Jax.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's - Grandmaster's Might (R) deals magic damage too
Jax.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both
Jax.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs heavy burst

Jayce.build_note: Ranged: Q cannon blast long range; W energy field slows; E accelerated cannon far Q. Melee: Q hammer dash; W AOE lightning slam; E thunder clap AOE. Combo: E accelerate → ranged Q launch → swap to melee → melee Q dash to target → W lightning slam. Manage swap cooldown (6s) - don't swap mid-trade. In ARAM: ranged form for poke phase, melee for all-in.
Jayce.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's - physical with magic mixed damage
Jayce.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both
Jayce.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs burst

Jhin.build_note: 26.9 Boots of Swiftness over Berserker's - Jhin's MS scales with crit (passive), and 4-shot reload doesn't gain from AS boots. Movement = damage for Jhin.
Jhin.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards (52.0% WR) replaces Rapid Firecannon - armor pen for 4-shot reload
Jhin.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder (48.7% WR) replaces Lord Dominik's slot - Jhin lethality kit prefers pen over crit slot
Jhin.vs_burst: Edge of Night (54.0% WR) OR Bloodthirster (52.5% WR) - 4-shot reload makes him vulnerable
Jhin.kit_notes: Passive Whisper: 4 shots per reload, 4th shot crits + applies %missing-HP damage. R (Curtain Call) channeled global snipe, 4 shots, 4th = guaranteed crit + execute. Q (Dancing Grenade) bounces, deals more on lower-HP targets. W (Deadly Flourish) long-range root through marked targets.
Jhin.aram_specific: ARAM neutral. R from spawn at low-HP enemies - fire 4 shots, last is guaranteed crit-execute. Reload windows are death traps - back off to safe range every 4 shots.

Jinx.build_note: Yun Tal Wildarrows (53.3% WR per the external aggregator with 5999 matches) is a viable variant first item - listed as core if rune is Lethal Tempo. Standard Runaan+IE crit build for AOE Q-rocket teamfight DPS.
Jinx.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards (54.6% WR) in core - Jinx Q-rocket already AOE, %pen amps it
Jinx.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder (54.9% WR) replaces Lord Dominik's slot - anti-tank/anti-heal exclusive choice
Jinx.vs_burst: Bloodthirster (59.2% WR) in core - Jinx is glass cannon, lifesteal shield is mandatory
Jinx.kit_notes: Passive Get Excited: kill or assist grants huge MS for 4s. Q toggle: Pow-Pow (mini-gun, AS stacking) or Fishbones (rocket, AOE + range). W (Zap!) long-range slow + reveal. E (Flame Chompers) bear-trap zone. R (Super Mega Death Rocket) global %missing-HP execute.
Jinx.aram_specific: ARAM neutral. R from spawn at low-HP enemies - Get Excited stacks per kill, Jinx becomes uncatchable late game. Q-rocket AOE shreds full enemy team in ARAM choke.

Kai'Sa.build_note: Lethal Tempo on-hit hybrid - Rageblade+Nashor evolves W early, Terminus shred for late.
Kai'Sa.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces The Collector - evolves W at 100 AP
Kai'Sa.kit_notes: Hybrid evolve ADC; AP/AS/AD breakpoints unlock W/Q/E evolutions - itemize for which evolve you need.

Kalista.build_note: Lethal Tempo on-hit - BORK+Runaan+Rageblade rips through ARAM tank stacks via spear procs.
Kalista.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow 5th as shield vs burst
Kalista.kit_notes: Hop-AA spear-stacker; pair with the right Howling Abyss tank for R-pull engages.

Karma.build_note: Dark Harvest poke build via Malignance is most-popular; pure damage Luden's path scales harder.
Karma.vs_burst: Locket of the Iron Solari replaces Moonstone vs heavy burst
Karma.kit_notes: Mage/support hybrid; mantra-shielded W and E shield-on-the-move are the scaling buttons.
_filtered_items: Substituted Liandry's Torment as 3rd core in place of source-listed 'Stormsurge' duplicate slot - kept Stormsurge in core.

Karthus.build_note: Tier dropped to C - 50.7% WR. Karthus's R-from-base playstyle is consistent but the kit doesn't gain from any 26.9 changes. Standard Liandry + Shadowflame double-burn build remains correct.
Karthus.vs_tanks: Void Staff in core - %magic pen scales vs MR/HP stackers
Karthus.vs_healing: Morellonomicon (49.4% WR) replaces Shadowflame vs Soraka/Yuumi
Karthus.vs_burst: Zhonya's Hourglass (55.3% WR) replaces Void Staff - invuln during R channel is the canonical Karthus tech
Karthus.kit_notes: Passive (Death Defied): on death, 7 seconds of free abilities. R (Requiem) global execute - fire from spawn at low-HP enemies. Q (Lay Waste) outer ring deals 2x damage if it hits only one target. E (Defile) AOE drain - toggle on in fights, off when low mana.
Karthus.aram_specific: ARAM neutral. Death Defied + free R from grave is the trademark - open fights, die mid-fight, ult low-HP carry from grave for double damage. Don't waste R on full-HP targets.

Kassadin.build_note: Mana-stack scaler - RoA+Archangel scaling is mandatory; Lich Bane procs R-Q chains late.
Kassadin.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke damage
Kassadin.kit_notes: Anti-mage scaler; R is short-CD on stacks but ARAM lane-length neuters his roam advantage.

Katarina.build_note: Reset mechanic: every kill/assist reduces all CDs by 15s. Combo: W dagger drop → E blink to dagger → Shunpo Q → R Sinister Steel spin. R requires stay in place - only channel when you have a reset from prior kill OR have Zhonya's ready. Never R without escape plan. E blinks to daggers OR to enemies - pick up daggers first for damage bonus.
Katarina.vs_tanks: Void Staff - all sources magic damage
Katarina.vs_healing: No anti-heal - burst carry then reset
Katarina.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Lich Bane vs burst

Kayle.build_note: Guinsoo's Rageblade converts crit chance to double on-hit procs - synergizes with Nashor's. Level 11+ ranged flame swords: stand at max range and auto the entire team. W heal before diving. R makes one ally invincible - ult your carry during enemy R, not afterward.
Kayle.vs_tanks: Void Staff - ranged magic flame swords melt tanks
Kayle.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Riftmaker vs burst

Kayn.build_note: Darkin form (Rhaast - fighting tanks/bruisers): heals from abilities. Shadow Assassin (Blue - fighting squishies): bonus magic damage burst. Reaping Slash (Q) dash. Blade's Reach (W) AOE vertical. Shadow Step (E) wall-walk. Umbral Trespass (R) enter and burst from inside target. In ARAM: collect Darkin orbs vs frontline or Shadow Assassin orbs vs carries. Rhaast build for tanks. Blue needs full lethality build instead.
Kayn.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's for Darkin; Rhaast form only - Blue Kayn uses different build
Kayn.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs 2+ healing
Kayn.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow for Rhaast form vs burst

Kennen.build_note: Mark of the Storm stacks from abilities - 3 marks = stun. Thundering Shuriken (Q) long range mark. Electrical Surge (W) AOE proc + passive mark reset. Lightning Rush (E) dash with bonus armor/MR during channel. Slicing Maelstrom (R) AOE constant lightning storm - stand inside the enemy group during R for maximum hits and stuns. Nashor's + R = on-hit marks during storm.
Kennen.vs_tanks: Void Staff - all magic; Mark of the Storm (passive) stun on 3 hits
Kennen.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Kha'Zix.build_note: Unseen Threat (passive) when emerging from brush/stealth: bonus damage + slow on auto. Taste Their Fear (Q) deals bonus damage to isolated targets - burst carries isolated from allies. Void Spike (W) poke + heal at range. Leap (E) resets on kill. R Void Assault: 3 brief stealth uses reset Unseen Threat. ARAM: use brush edges to proc Unseen Threat before each combo.
Kha'Zix.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's - physical damage full armor pen stack
Kha'Zix.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both
Kha'Zix.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Serpent's Fang vs burst

Kindred.build_note: Mark targets via Lamb's Respite passive (R passive): collecting marks increases all damage. Mark the enemy carry. Wolf's Frenzy (W) wolf attacks nearby enemies - place inside enemy group. Dance of Arrows (Q) 3-hit bounce off terrain. R (Lamb's Respite) ground makes ALL units unkillable briefly - use to save your team from a losing fight OR deny enemy from finishing.
Kindred.vs_tanks: Kraken + LDR - marks increase damage output; use LDR vs heavy tanks
Kindred.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both
Kindred.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces The Collector vs dive

Kled.build_note: Dismount mechanic: at 0 HP Kled falls off Skaarl - remount by dealing damage. Violent Tendencies (W passive) every 8s: 4 empowered autos that deal % max HP. Jousting (E) two-part dash: forward then recast to return. Chaaaaarge!!! (R) charge ALL teammates toward target - massive teamwide engage. In ARAM: R initiates the whole team. Use E forward then remount with W procs if dismounted.
Kled.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's - Skaarl dismount and remount mechanic
Kled.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both

Kog'Maw.build_note: AP/on-hit hybrid. W (Bio-Arcane Barrage) deals % max HP magic damage - active as much as possible. Nashor's Tooth + W = sustained tank shred. No dashes, no escapes - play at max W range (680). Stack AP to maximize % HP damage. R (Living Artillery) for long-range execute from safety.
Kog'Maw.vs_tanks: Kraken Slayer + Void Staff - W % max HP damage through MR
Kog'Maw.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder stays in core build
Kog'Maw.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Mortal Reminder if heavy poke/burst

LeBlanc.build_note: Distortion (W) two-part: land, recast to return. Combo: Q-mark → W-dash → auto → E-chain → W-return. Mimic (R) copies last ability: R-W = double Distortion for maximum gap-close burst. Ethereal Chains (E) root on second hit - use to lock down target before full combo. Shatter Orb (Q) mark: next ability on Q'd target deals bonus damage.
LeBlanc.vs_tanks: Void Staff - all magic; burst one target at a time
LeBlanc.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs ranged poke burst

Lee Sin.build_note: Sonic Wave (Q1) → Resonating Strike (Q2) dash to target. Safeguard (W1) dash to ally → Iron Will (W2) sustain. Tempest (E1) AOE blind → Cripple (E2) slow. Dragon's Rage (R) kick target: kicks target AND any enemies behind them. ARAM kick combo: kick the carry into your entire team. Ward hop: W to ward placed in safe position for escape. Flurry (passive) next 2 autos after ability are enhanced - weave autos between abilities.
Lee Sin.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's - physical burst all abilities
Lee Sin.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both
Lee Sin.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs heavy burst

Leona.build_note: Zenith Blade (E) dash + root on far enemy - use to initiate. Eclipse (W) gives auto attack empowerment and brief invulnerability - activate before taking damage. Solar Flare (R) AOE stun from distance - use to peel when enemy dives your backline. Sunlight passive: every stun/root applies Sunlight for 2s, ally autos pop it for bonus magic damage.
Leona.vs_tanks: Thornmail - Sunlight passive applies to all enemies hit by ally abilities
Leona.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst comps

Lillia.build_note: Lilting Lullaby (R) puts ALL enemies with Dream on them to sleep - apply Dream with any ability, then R sleeps them all. Blooming Blows (Q) aura damage + MS stack on hit. Watch Out! Eep! (W) slam AOE damage. Swirlseed (E) bouncing ball with sleep on landing. ARAM: keep Dream stacked on multiple enemies by AOE abilities, then R for mass sleep. Zhonya's during the sleep to survive counter-engage.
Lillia.vs_tanks: Void Staff - all magic; Lilting Lullaby puts enemies to sleep for easy follows
Lillia.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Lissandra.build_note: Glacial Path (E) claw - re-cast to teleport to claw location: use to escape OR flank. Ice Shard (Q) passes through and splits. Ring of Frost (W) AOE root. Frozen Tomb (R) freeze self for 2.5s invulnerable (free Zhonya's on demand) OR freeze an enemy for same duration. ARAM: R yourself when dove by multiple enemies - invulnerable + Zhonya's is essentially 5s immunity.
Lissandra.vs_tanks: Void Staff - all magic, Rylai slow keeps enemies in ice zone
Lissandra.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Shadowflame vs burst mages

Lucian.build_note: Tier D - 47.1% WR. Lucian's lane-bully kit doesn't translate to ARAM teamfight (no laning phase to snowball). Standard ER+Navori AS-and-CDR build - best of bad options.
Lucian.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards (50.8% WR) in core - Lucian needs %pen vs ARAM-tank meta
Lucian.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder (41.7% WR - bad) - Lucian struggles vs healing in general
Lucian.vs_burst: Blade of The Ruined King (50.7% WR) replaces The Collector - shield bonus + sustain
Lucian.kit_notes: Passive Lightslinger: ability cast empowers next 2 AAs (double-shot). Q (Piercing Light) line damage, dash-able. E (Relentless Pursuit) dash - refunds CD on Lightslinger procs. R (The Culling) channeled barrage - 24 shots in 3s. Combo is Q-AA-AA-W-AA-AA-E for max DPS.
Lucian.aram_specific: ARAM neutral. R is hard-CC'd easily in ARAM density - only ult after enemy dashes/flashes used. Lightslinger procs are damage - always cast Q before AAs even at full mana.

Lulu.build_note: Tier D - 46.2% WR. Lulu's enchanter kit struggles in ARAM teamfight density. Build is enchanter-canon (Ardent+Redemption+Locket) but the win condition is having a hyper-carry ally - solo-Lulu loses.
Lulu.vs_tanks: Mikael's Blessing (51.0% WR) replaces Locket - Lulu has no anti-tank tools, lean utility
Lulu.vs_healing: Morellonomicon (41.3% WR - worst) only if zero other anti-heal source on team
Lulu.vs_burst: Locket of the Iron Solari already core (53.6% WR) - best-WR situational item for her
Lulu.kit_notes: W (Whimsy) polymorph enemy OR speed boost ally - top Lulu skill. R (Wild Growth) ally HP buff + AOE knockup around them - ult dive carry at low HP. E (Help, Pix!) damage enemy OR shield ally - peel tool.
Lulu.aram_specific: +10% damage taken in ARAM. Pair with hyper-carry ADC (Vayne/Twitch/Kog'Maw) - R+W on them is win-fight. Solo without carry = grief tier.

Lux.build_note: Burst-mage canon: Luden's wave clear + first-spell amp, Stormsurge MS-on-takedown for kite, Shadowflame extra %pen below 40% HP. Highest-WR variant uses Blackfire Torch instead of Luden's at 56% WR (small sample 339).
Lux.vs_tanks: Void Staff replaces Shadowflame 5th - % magic pen scales vs MR stackers
Lux.vs_healing: Morellonomicon replaces Stormsurge vs Soraka/Sona - sacrifice burst for cut
Lux.vs_burst: Zhonya's Hourglass replaces Rabadon's vs heavy assassin pressure (Zed/Talon poke)
Lux.kit_notes: E (Lucent Singularity) AOE slow + delayed detonation - leads R for guaranteed hit. R (Final Spark) executes low HP across map; combo Q-root into E-detonate into R for full-damage one-shot. Passive procs every other auto on damaged target - weave AAs between abilities.
Lux.aram_specific: +5% damage dealt in ARAM, -5% damage taken. Long-range R from base wall punishes recall-less enemies. Watch flash CDs - single Q-root sets up entire team kill window.

variants.note: Dark Harvest + Blackfire 56.0% WR - niche but topples mage mirror

Malphite.build_note: AP-Malphite chassis: Malignance ult-CDR + Stormsurge proc; Grasp+Luden's hits 56.6% WR niche.
Malphite.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle Stoneplate vs pure burst
Malphite.kit_notes: AP-burst rock - passive shield + R unstoppable engage one-shots clumped ARAM teams.

Malzahar.build_note: Burn-mage chassis (Blackfire+Liandry+Rylai's) maximises E DoT spread across the ARAM clump.
Malzahar.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Morellonomicon (he already has passive void shield)
Malzahar.kit_notes: Voidling mage with point-click suppress R - pick a carry, suppress, evaporate.

Maokai.build_note: Tier B - 51.0% WR. Heartsteel + Winter's Approach mana stacking is the new tank meta - drops Sunfire/old-Bami for proc-on-Q damage. Unending Despair is the Maokai signature item (AOE heal/damage).
Maokai.vs_tanks: Thornmail in core (52.4% WR) - Maokai sapling AAs apply Grievous Wounds
Maokai.vs_healing: Unending Despair (55.1% WR - best Maokai item) - already core, AOE dot applies Grievous
Maokai.vs_burst: Spirit Visage (54.3% WR) in core - boosts MR + %healing - anti-burst tank
Maokai.kit_notes: Passive Sap Magic: every 4th AA against champ heals. Q (Bramble Smash) outer rim knocks back / inner rim knocks toward Maokai. W (Twisted Advance) targeted root-dash - engage tool. R (Nature's Grasp) global root wave - fire from base into teamfight choke.
Maokai.aram_specific: ARAM neutral. R global wave from spawn is poke + setup - every 60s free enemy displacement. W-engage is the kill button - root single carry, team follows.

Master Yi.build_note: Alpha Strike (Q) makes Yi untargetable briefly - use during enemy burst (Malphite R, Lux R) to dodge it entirely. Meditate (W) channels massive healing - use at 20% HP behind cover to regen to fighting health. Highlander (R) reset on kill/assist: chain R kills through grouped teams. Never engage without a near-kill opportunity - need the reset to survive. Guinsoo's Rageblade as 3rd item if carrying consistently.
Master Yi.vs_tanks: Kraken Slayer + LDR - Yi's resets make him need one anti-heal slot
Master Yi.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR if 2+ sustain enemies - never both
Master Yi.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Ravenous Hydra vs heavy burst

Miss Fortune.build_note: Collector first for early lethality + execute. LDR is the default armor pen (mandatory vs Malphite/Amumu/Rammus). IE requires 60% crit - with Collector (25%) + LDR (0%) = only 25% before IE. Fix: add Phantom Dancer or RFC as 3rd item for crit before IE. Bullet Time into grouped ARAM = free penta potential every fight.
Miss Fortune.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards mandatory - Collector (25%) + Phantom Dancer (20%) = 45% before IE; LDR has 0% crit
Miss Fortune.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies - never run both
Miss Fortune.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Phantom Dancer if 3+ divers - delays IE but shields during ult
Miss Fortune.kit_notes: Double Up (Q) bounces off enemies hit by E-marked targets for double damage. Love Tap passive: alternate between targets for bonus damage. Strut (W) - fully charge before every fight by staying out of combat 5s. Bullet Time channels through frontline - position at 30-45 degree angle to hit 3+ enemies.
Miss Fortune.aram_specific: Pre-channel position: find 30-45 degree angle so Bullet Time hits 3+ grouped enemies. Never ult into a single target. Strut is free movement speed if you don't get hit in lane brush - stay behind minions to farm Strut stacks freely.

Mordekaiser.build_note: 26.9 ARAM build pivoted to Riftmaker core (replacing former Liandry-rush) - Riftmaker omnivamp converts his sustained-damage R into 1v1 unkillability. Rylai 2nd for kite-slow. Spirit Visage triples Riftmaker heal; Rabadon scales late.
Mordekaiser.vs_tanks: Liandry's Torment 4th - replaces Spirit Visage when 3+ tanks (%-HP burn through health stacking)
Mordekaiser.vs_healing: Morellonomicon swaps Rylai's vs Soraka/Sona/Yuumi - keep Rylai if no major healer
Mordekaiser.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Spirit Visage vs heavy AP poke (Lux/Xerath/Ziggs comp)
Mordekaiser.kit_notes: Passive Darkness Rise: hitting 3 enemies with abilities or 2 autos grants AOE damage aura + MS. R Realm of Death isolates highest-HP enemy in 1v1 dimension for 7s, stealing 10% stats and dragging soul if killed. Drain target with E (Death's Grasp) pull then walk into them - Riftmaker burn carries the duel.
Mordekaiser.aram_specific: 100% damage taken in ARAM (no modifier). R isolation is the win condition - ult highest-priority carry every fight. No recall means Doran's start is wasted; Haunting Guise rush.

variants.note: External aggregator surface - Liandry-instead-of-Riftmaker; viable when enemy is 3+ tanky

Morgana.build_note: Dark Binding (Q) root for 3s - aim at feet of moving targets. Tormented Soil (W) AOE burn: melts tanks and grouped enemies over 5s. Black Shield (E) absorbs crowd control AND magic damage on one ally - save for hard CC like Amumu R or Nautilus hook. Soul Shackles (R) chain to all nearby enemies - Zhonya's yourself mid-R to extend and prevent interrupt.
Morgana.vs_tanks: Void Staff - all magic; W pool burns through MR
Morgana.vs_healing: No anti-heal - Tormented Soil sustain damage
Morgana.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs burst

Naafiri.build_note: Electrocute lethality - Hubris stacking from minion executes scales fast in ARAM wave fights.
Naafiri.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder (substitute swap if heavy heal comp)
Naafiri.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Serpent's Fang vs burst
Naafiri.kit_notes: Pack-of-dogs assassin; W dash + R packlings = forced engage on the single ARAM lane.
_filtered_items: Source did not list explicit anti-heal item; Mortal Reminder added per project guidance.

Nami.build_note: Aqua Prison (Q) bubble - aim at feet of moving enemies, not where they are. Ebb and Flow (W) healing/damage bounces 3 times - start on ally to heal, then bounce to enemy. Tidecaller's Blessing (E) buffs ally autos with slow - put on your ADC. R (Tidal Wave) knocks up entire corridor in a line - throw at grouped enemies approaching. Buff carry with E before fights.
Nami.vs_burst: Locket of the Iron Solari replaces Mikael's vs burst

Nasus.build_note: Stack Siphoning Strike (Q) on EVERY minion - each cannon kill = +12 stacks, champion kill = +6. By 100 stacks Q does massive damage. R (Fury of the Sands) gives HP, 3x Q bonus damage, and AOE aura damage for 15s - use at grouped fights. Spirit Fire (E) reduces enemy armor - E a group before Q empowered auto. ARAM gives free farm opportunity - Q every cannon without mercy.
Nasus.vs_tanks: Thornmail - autos apply grievous; Siphoning Strike shreds tanks when stacked
Nasus.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst

Nautilus.build_note: Grasp Heartsteel/Winter's tank - mana-to-shield + 5k HP makes him uncrowdable.
Nautilus.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst
Nautilus.kit_notes: Q hook + passive AA root chain-CCs anyone he touches; R for the back-line.

Neeko.build_note: Dark Harvest burst - Luden's into Malignance is highest WR alt; Shadowflame is the squishy execute.
Neeko.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Rylai's vs poke comps
Neeko.kit_notes: AoE mage with disguise-engage R; bushes + clone fakes win the Howling Abyss flanks.

Nidalee.build_note: Javelin Toss (Q human) at maximum range deals 200%+ damage - always throw from max range. Pounce (cougar Q) resets when hitting a hunted target. Hunt passive: Javelin and trap hits mark targets as hunted. Combo: Q long range spear → transform cougar → Pounce (reset) → Takedown Q → Swipe E. Primal Surge (W human) heals ally or self - maintain health for aggressive cougar dives.
Nidalee.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke

Nilah.build_note: Rush Kraken Slayer -> BotRK -> Immortal Shieldbow. MELEE in ARAM-play for skirmish windows not poke wars. Engage with ally CC, never alone. Skip RFC (melee range, can't reach bonus).

Nocturne.build_note: Duskbringer (Q) trail gives AS and moves through enemies. Shroud of Darkness (W) passive AS boost; active spell shield once. Unspeakable Horror (E) fears after 2s of attachment. Paranoia (R) reduces enemy vision to near-zero AND dashes to one target. ARAM: R cuts off enemy vision - perfect timing when enemy engages or groups at health packs.
Nocturne.vs_tanks: LDR - Collector(25%)+Navori(25%)=50% crit, LDR for armor pen on frontline
Nocturne.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDiar vs healing - never both

Nunu & Willump.build_note: Call of the Freljord (passive) nearby allies gain AS and MS. Consume (Q) huge self-heal based on target HP - eat a minion at 30% HP to restore massive amounts. Biggest Snowball Ever! (W) rolling ball that grows and knocks up - aim diagonally across ARAM corridor for max distance and knock-up. Snowball Barrage (E) AOE root. Absolute Zero (R) channeled massive AOE that increases in damage - protect Nunu during R or Zhonya's for 2.5s extend.
Nunu & Willump.vs_tanks: Thornmail - Snowball Barrage (E) AOE + Absolute Zero (R) does % max HP
Nunu & Willump.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst

Olaf.build_note: Berserker Rage (passive) - increases AS as HP decreases: fight at LOW HP. R (Ragnarok) makes Olaf CC-immune - walk through any CC to reach the backline. E (Reckless Swing) deals fixed HP damage to both Olaf and target - use at 20% HP when passive is maxed for insane DPS. Use R aggressively - engage, kill one, reset fights.
Olaf.vs_tanks: Thornmail - Ragnarok (R) makes him untargetable by CC, walks through tanks

W Iron Mantle shields and heals. E Blazing Stampede dashes to target. Phoenix Stance (R) AOE lightning storm AoE - the primary damage dealer. Cycle Q for damage burst, R for sustained AOE. Sunfire Aegis stacks with R stance for constant AOE damage.
Udyr.vs_tanks: Thornmail - Wingborne Storm (R) deals max HP magic damage

Urgot.build_note: Purge (W) leg slam fires: hold W and run into enemies for sustained on-hit damage through Sunfire Aegis. Disdain (E) charge catches enemy and throws them to the other side - throw carry into your team. Corrosive Charge (Q) slows target - Q before W for slow target during Purge. Fear Beyond Death (R) execute threshold + scythe-chain to low HP target then executes them. Sunfire + W = standing AOE melting everything nearby.
Urgot.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's - Purge (W) fires legs dealing physical on-hit damage
Urgot.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both

Varus.build_note: Manamune lethality - Q-poke chassis; Serylda's slow on Q chunk locks targets for the team.
Varus.vs_healing: Edge of Night (spell-shield blocks initial heal-engage spells)
Varus.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Phantom Dancer vs heavy dive
Varus.kit_notes: Lethality poke ADC on this map; Q charge from max range whittles before fights start.

Vayne.build_note: 26.9 Doran's Bow start (NEW item - 6 AD, 12-15% AS, 1.5% omnivamp, 400g) replaces old Doran's Blade. Vayne's primary on-hit champ, perfect new starter. BotRK + Rageblade + Wit's End is the on-hit holy trinity - Kraken Slayer 4th replaces traditional IE for true damage.
Vayne.vs_tanks: Kraken Slayer (56.6% WR) + Fiendhunter Bolts (61.8% WR) - Vayne true damage stack, both proc-on-AA
Vayne.vs_healing: Terminus (54.6% WR) on-hit %pen ramp - Fiendhunter Bolts also doubles as anti-heal
Vayne.vs_burst: Jak'Sho, The Protean (53.6% WR) - gives Vayne survival vs magic-burst comps
Vayne.kit_notes: Passive Final Hour (R active): bonus AD + invisibility on Q tumble + faster passive proc. W (Silver Bolts) every 3rd AA on same target = %max-HP true damage - Rageblade halves this. E (Condemn) knockback into wall = stun. Q (Tumble) repositioning + bonus damage.
Vayne.aram_specific: ARAM neutral. Vayne suffers without escape options - Q tumble through wall is the only safety. Q-invisibility in R lets her dodge skillshots - pop R for both damage AND positioning.

Veigar.build_note: Note tier dropped to B - the external aggregator shows 50.5% WR / 14913 games. Rod of Ages variant (52.6% WR, 2311 games) is the high-WR sub-build for sustain mage style. Luden burst remains baseline.
Veigar.vs_tanks: Void Staff in core - Veigar's flat AP scaling already shreds MR with %pen
Veigar.vs_healing: Shadowflame is execute amp not anti-heal - add Morellonomicon 6th vs Soraka
Veigar.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil (51.4% WR) replaces Shadowflame vs assassin dive - Zhonya's bad here (47.3% WR)
Veigar.kit_notes: Passive Phenomenal Evil: stacks AP on ability hit + champion takedown - Veigar's win condition is stack accumulation. E (Event Horizon) ring stuns enemies who walk through perimeter (not center). R (Primordial Burst) executes - bonus damage % missing HP. Stack on minions early game.
Veigar.aram_specific: ARAM is Veigar's stack-paradise - every minion kill = passive stack. 200+ stacks by game-end is realistic. R one-shots squishies past 800 AP.

variants.note: Rod of Ages 2nd (52.6% WR) - slower spike but max HP+AP scaling for late-game R one-shots

Vel'Koz.build_note: S-tier identity is true-damage R that burns through tanks. Standard mage-burst build (Luden+Shadowflame+Rabadon) - Vel'Koz scales hard with flat AP for both ability and R damage. AOE channel means 5-target ult in narrow lane.
Vel'Koz.vs_tanks: Void Staff replaces Stormsurge 6th - Vel'Koz passive true damage already shreds
Vel'Koz.vs_healing: Morellonomicon (49.4% WR) replaces Stormsurge vs Soraka/Sona
Vel'Koz.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil (45.3% WR - bad) - keep Stormsurge MS escape instead vs dive
Vel'Koz.kit_notes: Passive Organic Deconstruction: 3 stacks of any ability detonate for true damage - Q-W-E or Q-Q-E full combo procs immediately. R (Lifeform Disintegration Ray) channeled wide cone + %max-HP true damage - fire after 3-stack proc for full burst.
Vel'Koz.aram_specific: +5% damage dealt, neutral taken - minor ARAM buff. R is the highest single-cast damage in mode for AOE; cast from off-angle to avoid CC interrupt. Q splits on first impact = waveclear and harass simultaneously.

Vex.build_note: Doom 'n Gloom (passive): every 25s an ability applies Fear. Misery (Q) AOE slow - proc Gloom on multiple targets. Personal Space (W) shield + shockwave when hit - use vs auto attackers. Looming Darkness (E) AOE slow + Fear. Shadow Surge (R) resets on kill - use on squishy, then chain R resets into the whole team. R marks target: if they die, R resets with 4s window.
Vex.vs_tanks: Void Staff - fear passive reduces incoming poke safety
Vex.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs poke damage

Vi.build_note: Denting Blows (W passive) every 3 autos reduces target armor by 20% for 4s - focus one target with 3 autos before Q or R. Vault Breaker (Q) charge dash: hold to extend range. Excessive Force (E) launches blast through target. Cease and Desist (R) targeted dash that locks onto enemy - cannot be stopped. In ARAM: R the carry → W 3-auto armor shred → Q reset → burst combo.
Vi.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's - physical damage armor pen stack
Vi.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both

Viktor.build_note: Evolve Q first for shield during teamfights. E (Death Ray) upgraded = creates explosion trail: fire E → laser → explosion AOE combo. W (Gravity Field) slow + stun in corridor - place to control health pack approaches. R (Chaos Storm) moveable: drag through grouped enemies continuously. Augment stacks from takeoffs - use Q shield in every fight.
Viktor.vs_tanks: Void Staff - laser melts tanks with magic pen
Viktor.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Zhonya's vs ability poke

Volibear.build_note: The Relentless Storm (passive): AS increases as fight continues - stay in prolonged fights. Frenzied Maul (W) bite: heals Volibear based on damage dealt AND applies grievous. Sky Splitter (E) lightning bolt delayed AOE. Stormbringer (R) leap slam: disables nearby towers for 5s AND is huge AOE - leap into ARAM chokepoint for max value. W provides self-grievous cure - heal through incoming grievous.
Volibear.vs_tanks: Thornmail - autos reduce enemy heal; Thundering Smash (Q) stun
Volibear.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst

Warwick.build_note: Blood Hunt (E) - track enemies below 50% HP through walls. R (Infinite Duress) suppresses one target for 1.5s - use on the carry, never the tank. Q (Jaws of the Beast) locks onto target through walls - use on fleeing enemies. Primal Howl (W) reduces damage by 40% for 2.5s - activate before taking burst. Build tanky: he already heals from Q, TF gives HP.
Warwick.vs_tanks: Thornmail - Infinite Duress suppresses while allies kill the carry

Wukong.build_note: Warrior Trickster (W) clone: drops decoy then stealth for 1s - bait abilities with decoy. Crushing Blow (Q) reduces enemy armor for 3s. Cyclone (R) two-charge spin - can interrupt with movement. ARAM: R through the entire corridor for grouped knock-up. TF Spellblade procs on Q for bonus burst. Clone placement: drop clone in enemy team, stealth behind, then R from surprise angle.
Wukong.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's - physical damage with AOE spin
Wukong.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both
Wukong.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs burst

Xayah.build_note: Season 16: Yun Tal Wildarrows gives 0% crit (pure AS). Build RFC second for 25% crit, then Collector for 50% crit before IE (75% total, IE fully active). R (Featherstorm) invincibility on demand is ARAM's best defensive ADC ability - use it to dodge every ult and engage.
Xayah.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards 5th - Feathers bounce through tanks for good damage
Xayah.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies - never run both
Xayah.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow 4th replaces The Collector - still hits 50% crit for IE
Xayah.kit_notes: Auto-E-auto pattern: autos plant feathers, E pulls them back rooting caught enemies. Double Daggers (Q) fires two feathers - use before E for maximum feather recall. R Featherstorm: INVINCIBLE during - use it to dodge any CC or burst. Rakan passive (Lovers' Leap) only if Rakan is your support.
Xayah.aram_specific: Time R to dodge the enemy's biggest ability (Malphite R, Amumu R, Lux R). Never pre-cast R - wait to see the threat. Plant feathers with autos first, then use E to pull them back through grouped enemies for AOE root. Crowd the middle of ARAM for maximum feather coverage.

Xerath.build_note: Tier B - 51.5% WR. Pure-poke caster - no item innovation needed, classic Luden+Shadowflame+Rabadon AP stack is optimal. Stormsurge MS-on-takedown helps R-positioning.
Xerath.vs_tanks: Void Staff replaces Stormsurge 6th - Xerath's flat-AP needs %pen vs MR
Xerath.vs_healing: Morellonomicon (39.6% WR - worst situational) only vs heavy healing
Xerath.vs_burst: Zhonya's Hourglass (48.9% WR) replaces Stormsurge vs assassin dive
Xerath.kit_notes: Q (Arcanopulse) charge-up beam - hold for max damage range. W (Eye of Destruction) AOE skillshot center deals bonus damage. E (Shocking Orb) long-range stun - stun length scales with travel distance. R (Rite of the Arcane) global 3 charges; aim with reticule, fire from base.
Xerath.aram_specific: +10% damage taken - Xerath glass-cannon nerf in ARAM. Long-range R from base is the value play; reticle-aim at low-HP enemies. Q charge cancellable with E or W - fake Q to bait dodges.

Xin Zhao.build_note: Three Talon Strike (Q) reduces CD per hit - spam for knock-ups. Audacious Charge (E) dash to target, slows nearby. Crescent Guard (R) creates a zone that ONLY Xin Zhao and allies can be in - carries are displaced outside, tanks/frontline stay. In ARAM: R to split the carry from their team, burst them alone. Battle Cry (W) heals and gains AS - sustain in extended fights.
Xin Zhao.vs_tanks: LDR - physical, Three Talon Strike (Q) knock-up on third hit
Xin Zhao.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both
Xin Zhao.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Mortal Reminder vs burst

Yasuo.build_note: 26.9 Statikk Shiv reworked to AD/AP hybrid - NOT in current Yasuo build (he wants pure crit). BotRK 1st for %HP shred + lifesteal, Shieldbow safety, IE crit-amp.
Yasuo.vs_tanks: Death's Dance core - adds Mortal Reminder 5th vs healing tanks; BotRK already %current-HP
Yasuo.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder (58.2% WR) replaces Death's Dance - can't carry both anti-heal and lifesteal in same slot
Yasuo.vs_burst: Bloodthirster (59.1% WR) replaces Infinity Edge vs heavy poke - shield + lifesteal over crit damage
Yasuo.kit_notes: Passive: crit chance doubled, shield on movement. Q (Steel Tempest): 3rd Q is a tornado - line knock-up. E (Sweeping Blade) dashes through enemies - chain through minions to engage. R (Last Breath) only off knocked-up targets - pair with own Q3 or ally CC.
Yasuo.aram_specific: ARAM neutral. Q3-tornado from screen-edge knockup sets up R every fight; aim for back-line caster. Ally CC into R is the auto-pairing - call out Maokai/Annie/Jhin teams.

Yone.build_note: Way of the Hunter (passive): every other auto deals magic damage - build AD and it auto-converts 50% to magic. Mortal Steel (Q) double cast: two Q's in rapid succession dash forward. Spirit Cleave (W) cleaving AOE + shield from damage dealt. Soul Unbound (E) separates soul: soul flies forward freely for 5s, then snaps back dealing 8% damage taken. Fate Sealed (R) sweeping dash through enemies. E into enemy group → R sweep → return for damage.
Yone.vs_tanks: LDR - physical + magic split; armor pen applies to physical portion
Yone.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs healing - never both
Yone.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Sterak's vs heavy burst

Yorick.build_note: Last Rites (Q) empowered auto spawns ghoul on kill. Mourning Mist (W) marks area: Yorick and ghouls deal more damage to marked target. Mourning's End (R) summons Maiden of the Mist: Maiden is a powerful companion that fights independently and spawns Walkers. In ARAM: point Maiden at carry - she and ghouls will shred through anyone. Dark Procession (E) wall of ghouls that blocks movement - wall off enemy retreat path.
Yorick.vs_tanks: Thornmail - ghouls attack the entire enemy team; Maiden applies grievous

Yuumi.build_note: Aery enchanter - Moonstone+Censer+Redemption is the standard heal/shield triple-stack.
Yuumi.vs_tanks: Cosmic Drive (substitute when team needs movement speed and CDR over raw heal stack)
Yuumi.vs_healing: Morellonomicon (substitute on Yuumi when enemy comp out-heals)
Yuumi.vs_burst: Locket of the Iron Solari replaces Zhonya's - but Zhonya's while attached does nothing
Yuumi.kit_notes: Attached enchanter; W rides an ally and pumps shields/heals - no lane mobility issues here.
_filtered_items: Source did not list anti-tank or anti-heal swaps; substituted Cosmic Drive (utility) and Morellonomicon (Grievous) per project schema.

Zac.build_note: Grasp/Aftershock HP-tank - passive blob respawn loves Spirit Visage healing.
Zac.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Gargoyle vs burst
Zac.kit_notes: Elastic engage tank; E launch + R bounce is the back-line dive on this map.

Zed.build_note: W-R-W-E-Q-auto combo: cast W shadow → R on carry → W back to shadow for R extension → E shurikens → Q through target. Death Mark (R) marks target, detonates after 3s for bonus damage based on damage dealt. Duskblade invisibility after R in teamfights. ARAM note: short range - needs teammates to create the gap-close opportunity.
Zed.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's - full armor pen stack, physical damage only
Zed.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR if 2+ sustain enemies - never both
Zed.vs_burst: Sterak's Gage replaces Mortal Reminder vs burst

Zeri.build_note: Lethal Tempo crit - IE+Yun Tal+Runaan's gives the AoE chain her Q needs to actually scale.
Zeri.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Guinsoo's vs heavy burst
Zeri.kit_notes: Movement-speed ADC; E wall-jump is the only escape on the single-lane map - use it carefully.

Ziggs.build_note: Pure poke build - Luden waveclear + Liandry burn through ARAM HP pools + Shadowflame execute amp. Horizon Focus variant trades durability for proc-amp on his own E-stuns.
Ziggs.vs_tanks: Void Staff replaces Shadowflame 5th - Liandry already %HP burn
Ziggs.vs_healing: Morellonomicon replaces Liandry vs heavy healing - only if 2+ healers
Ziggs.vs_burst: Horizon Focus 2nd (57.1% WR) - bonus damage to immobilized + safety vs dive
Ziggs.kit_notes: W (Satchel Charge) launches enemies and self - both engage and disengage tool. R (Mega Inferno Bomb) global poke - fire from spawn at low-HP enemies for execute. Passive empowers AAs - weave between Q bounces for tower-clearing damage in regular lanes (less relevant ARAM).
Ziggs.aram_specific: +5% damage taken, -5% damage dealt (Riot's Ziggs nerf in ARAM). Q has high-damage center hitbox - aim through choke. Global R is the highest free-damage in mode; fire continuously from base.

Zilean.build_note: Tier D - 47.9% WR. Zilean's R-revive is huge utility but ARAM's poke meta pre-empts the value. Luden burst sub-build does best within Zilean's bad pool.
Zilean.vs_tanks: Void Staff in core - flat-AP utility kit doesn't natively shred
Zilean.vs_healing: Morellonomicon (45.0% WR - worst situational) only vs Soraka stacks
Zilean.vs_burst: Cryptbloom (49.4% WR) replaces Void Staff - healing aura + %magic pen
Zilean.kit_notes: Q+E double-bomb stun: stack 2 Qs on target then E-cast for instant detonate-stun. R (Chronoshift) revives ally with HP after 5s - save for diving carry. W (Time Warp) AOE haste/slow - chase or peel.
Zilean.aram_specific: ARAM neutral. R-revive on ally Mordekaiser/Sion mid-fight wins games - call out R targets pre-fight. Bomb stun is the only damage source - 1.5s lockdown for team to follow up.

Zoe.build_note: Sleepy Trouble Bubble (E) tosses to location - sleeping target takes DOUBLE damage from next hit. Full combo: E-sleep → Portal Jump (R) → Q amplified with sleep debuff. Paddle Star (Q) second cast redirects. Spell Thief (W) picks up summoner spells and item actives dropped by enemies - can pick up Flash for extra blink. Bubble through terrain. R Portal Jump: blink briefly and return - use as poke tool.
Zoe.vs_tanks: Void Staff - all magic; sleep combo amplifies all damage
Zoe.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Rylai's vs burst

Zyra.build_note: Plants spawn near seeds when abilities pass through them. Q (Deadly Spines) + W seed = vine lashers (slow). E (Grasping Roots) root + W seed = thornspitters (ranged). Layer seeds before fights then root into full plant garden. R (Stranglethorns) knock-up: use when enemy groups - all plants in range get enraged. Plant thorns at health pack approaches for zone control.
Zyra.vs_tanks: Void Staff - all magic; Rylai slow keeps enemies in plant range
Zyra.vs_burst: Banshee's Veil replaces Shadowflame vs burst

MissFortune.vs_tanks: Serylda's Grudge (52.6% WR) in core - %armor pen scales with lethality stacked on her build
MissFortune.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder (50.6% WR) replaces Serylda's - pick anti-heal vs anti-tank
MissFortune.vs_burst: Edge of Night (54.1% WR) replaces Axiom Arc - spell shield blocks engage CC
MissFortune.kit_notes: Passive Love Tap: bonus damage to new targets - switch AAs between enemies. Q (Double Up) bounces - kill minion to bounce to champ. E (Make It Rain) AOE slow zone - placed under enemy team. R (Bullet Time) channeled cone - center deals double damage; ARAM ult for full clumped enemy team.
MissFortune.build_note: 26.9 Axiom Arc note: ult-CD refund changed to 10% +0.25% per lethality (was 15% +0.15%). High-lethality MF builds gain refund scaling - this lethality-stack build benefits from the buff. Hubris was the old slot; the external aggregator shows Axiom Arc as the new high-WR pick.
MissFortune.aram_specific: +5% damage dealt in ARAM (small Riot buff). R from off-angle into clumped lane fight = highest-damage AOE in mode. Center cone is double - aim through center of enemy team.

Leblanc.kit_notes: Burst assassin with W gap+return and R clones - pick stragglers off the side of the lane.
Leblanc.build_note: Electrocute proc burst chain - Luden+Stormsurge two-tap squishies before they kite.

Mel.kit_notes: Long-range area-control mage (newer roster); poke and zone, R is the close-out.
Mel.build_note: Dark Harvest / Arcane Comet poke chassis - Luden+Shadowflame snowballs ARAM chip damage.

Sett.kit_notes: Brawler with W shield+true dmg and R fling - frontline initiator that doesn't die.
Sett.build_note: Grasp HP-stacker - Heartsteel + Overlord's + Warmog's = uncatchable in the ARAM funnel.

Anivia.vs_tanks: Liandry's Torment + Rylai's chunks tank HP and locks them in your wall.
Anivia.vs_healing: Swap Rylai's for Morellonomicon (or add Bloodletter's Curse) into heavy heal comps.
Anivia.kit_notes: Control mage; wall splits the team and Q->R combo zones any choke.
Anivia.build_note: Arcane Comet + RoA scales hardest; Liandry's online by item 4 for tank uptime.

KSante.vs_tanks: Swap Heartsteel for Kaenic Rookern to scale into tanky comps; R-engages still threaten backline.
KSante.vs_healing: Thornmail is mandatory; Unending Despair adds passive grievous-wound pressure.
KSante.kit_notes: Tank-bruiser; All Out (R) converts defenses to AD to brawl mid-fight.
KSante.build_note: Grasp + defensive stack; play front-to-back and engage with W shield up.

Milio.vs_tanks: Limited carry damage; bait poke with W shield and let frontline soak.
Milio.vs_healing: Healing reduced 5% in ARAM; double down on shields/CC cleanse via R rather than racing heals.
Milio.kit_notes: Pure enchanter; R cleanses CC and resets carry uptime in fights.
Milio.build_note: Aery into mana/AH; Ardent + Staff of Flowing Water boost ADC/AP carry uptime.

Viego.vs_tanks: BORK + Wit's End melt high-HP frontliners; possess after a kill to chain pressure.
Viego.vs_healing: Death's Dance bleed + Executioner's Calling early if heal comp; possession resets give you fresh cooldowns.
Viego.kit_notes: Bruiser-assassin; passive possession of dead enemies extends fights.
Viego.build_note: Conqueror line; Sundered Sky burst-heal lets him brawl into the backline.

Vladimir.vs_tanks: Liandry's + Riftmaker omnivamp scales into long fights; kite with W pool through their frontline.
Vladimir.vs_healing: Vlad's heal is reduced 10% in ARAM; build Morellonomicon over Cosmic Drive into heavy heal comps.
Vladimir.kit_notes: Hemomancer mage; W untargetability and R AoE amp make him a teamfight delay.
Vladimir.build_note: Dark Harvest + Riftmaker is the highest-WR line; needs 3 items before he stabilizes.

Yunara.vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's is mandatory; Fiendhunter Bolts pierce shields/HP stacking.
Yunara.vs_healing: Slot Mortal Reminder over Bloodthirster vs heavy heal comps.
Yunara.kit_notes: Attack-speed marksman; relies on uptime and Lethal Tempo to ramp damage.
Yunara.build_note: AS->IE->LDR power spike; play behind frontline since she has no escape.

Zaahen.vs_tanks: Spear of Shojin amps repeated Q hits; Sundered Sky + DD give brawl uptime against frontline.
Zaahen.vs_healing: Death's Dance bleed + add Executioner's into heavy heal stacks; he doesn't out-sustain heal comps.
Zaahen.kit_notes: Conqueror bruiser; max Q then E, Stridebreaker variant peaks at 62% WR but lower volume.
Zaahen.build_note: Sundered Sky line is the popular safe path; pivot Stridebreaker if comp wants engage.
